scenarioName: CHF Exacerbation — Hypertensive Pulmonary Edema with Nitrate-PDE5i Interaction

scenarioStory.history: Daughter reports the patient became acutely short of breath over the last hour while resting in her recliner, with pink frothy sputum and increasing anxiety. No chest pain reported, denies fever or recent illness. Patient has a history of pulmonary arterial hypertension managed with sildenafil.
scenarioStory.course: Initial Contact: Crew arrives to find a 76-year-old female in severe respiratory distress, tripoding, with pink frothy sputum, JVD, and diffuse bilateral rales. She is hypertensive and tachypneic, speaking only single words. → CPAP applied and med list screened: Crew applies CPAP with PEEP, obtains a full medication history including the patient's sildenafil use for pulmonary hypertension, and titrates high-dose sublingual nitroglycerin per the severe-hypertension dosing tier. → Med screen clear, nitro tolerated: With the medication screen clear, CPAP and titrated nitroglycerin steadily improve oxygenation and reduce blood pressure without the vasodilatory crash risked by a nitrate-PDE5i interaction. Mask seal is maintained continuously through transport.

patientInformation.patientCondition: Severe shortness of breath with pink frothy sputum

scenarioEvents.name: Initial Contact
scenarioEvents.description: Crew arrives to find a 76-year-old female in severe respiratory distress, tripoding, with pink frothy sputum, JVD, and diffuse bilateral rales. She is hypertensive and tachypneic, speaking only single words.

scenarioEvents.name: CPAP applied and med list screened
scenarioEvents.description: Crew applies CPAP with PEEP, obtains a full medication history including the patient's sildenafil use for pulmonary hypertension, and titrates high-dose sublingual nitroglycerin per the severe-hypertension dosing tier.
relatedChecklist: Apply CPAP with PEEP 5 cmH2O, coach patient, titrate for air hunger and SpO2 ≥94%
Screen medication list for PDE5 inhibitor or IV pulmonary-hypertension therapy before giving nitroglycerin
Nitroglycerin 0.8 mg SL for SBP ≥160 mmHg; may repeat every 5 min while SBP >100

scenarioEvents.name: Med screen clear, nitro tolerated
scenarioEvents.description: With the medication screen clear, CPAP and titrated nitroglycerin steadily improve oxygenation and reduce blood pressure without the vasodilatory crash risked by a nitrate-PDE5i interaction. Mask seal is maintained continuously through transport.
relatedChecklist: Maintain continuous CPAP mask seal through transport; do not break seal until ED handoff
Continuously monitor pulse oximetry and waveform capnography to guide ongoing therapy

scenarioEvents.name: Nitro given without med screen
scenarioEvents.description: Nitroglycerin was given without screening for PDE5-inhibitor use. The patient's home sildenafil potentiates the nitrate's vasodilatory effect, producing profound, refractory hypotension superimposed on her pulmonary edema.
relatedChecklist: 500 mL NS pressure-infused bolus for nitrate-induced hypotension; stop if pulmonary edema worsens
Norepinephrine infusion 3.4 mcg/min IV (68 kg × 0.05 mcg/kg/min), titrate up to 34 mcg/min to MAP ≥65 if hypotension persists
